intro: Mauritius grew from a sugar island into one of Africa's richest economies.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Tourism, textiles, financial services and sugar are major industries. It is a hub for investment into Africa and India.

chapters.title: Tourism
text: Beach resorts attract over a million visitors a year.

cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Mauritius makes and sells to the world.
